finding: CNN_LOCO_HOLDOUT renames one class rather than restructuring the label space: nine classes before and after, same partition of the training set. A softmax objective is invariant to class names, so LOCO training equals baseline training up to a permutation of output units, and p(UNKNOWN) is p(held-out family) - a family detector, not a novelty detector. The sweep was stopped after 1.5 of 12 runs.
caveats: Ties are reported beside every macro; a scorer with more than half the flows in one block is not comparable to one without.
Only models that were actually trained are scored - this makes no claim about hold-outs that never ran.
